title: Stereotype screen: review panel
story: A coordinator, a policy agent, two independent reviewers and a reconciler catch all 4 planted stereotypes. The judge tells valuable redundancy apart from one wasteful duplicate fetch.
content_note: Intentional example with planted stereotypes in a fictional public-health announcement. Not from a real campaign.
description: A coordinator routes a public health announcement to a policy agent, two independent reviewers and a reconciler, who flag stereotypes against an inclusive-communication checklist. Multi-agent, text only.
